run_rm_pt_delete_checkpoints: recursively delete checkpoint files from a directory while preserving checkpoint_best.pt and checkpoint_last.pt
run_rm_pt_save_last_n: delete checkpoint files but save the last N checkpoints using the --save-last flag
run_rm_pt_save_every_n: delete checkpoint files but save every Nth checkpoint using the --save-every flag
run_rm_pt_delete_best_last: delete all checkpoint files including checkpoint_best.pt and checkpoint_last.pt using --delete-best and --delete-last flags
run_rm_pt_desymlink_checkpoints: preserve checkpoint files by dereferencing symlinks and copying the real file content
